objective: Find how much native depth-zero exchange information must augment the compressed sign-channel carriers for pooled scalar transfer.
source: Canonical SIGNED_PARITY C/D0/D1 tokens; retain the existing base pair signature. From D0:0:+/-,D1:0:+/- derive exact four frontier indicators; each owner has at most one nonzero sign at depth0.

maps.ANY: whether any frontier indicator is nonzero
maps.TOTAL: number of changed frontier owner channels
maps.ABS_NET: absolute difference between plus and minus frontier counts
maps.UNORDERED: sorted pair of plus/minus frontier counts

control: SIGNED_PARITY|ZERO_VS_POSITIVE from RS085 remains a full native zero/bulk reconstruction control.
procedure: Enumerate all35 base/frontier combinations plus the full zero/bulk control. All pair maps are fixed before scalar replay.
For each pair append the chosen frontier symbol to the canonical base pair key, then sort the three pair keys for triangle identity.
Freeze all pooled catalogs, rows, bases and complete kernels, commit, then replay aligned pinned codes.
Reproduce NONE controls from RS082 and native zero/bulk from RS085. Publish per-carrier and pooled consistency, complete scalar kernel image and the three fixed scalar characters.
Derive the frontier-mode partition order exhaustively on the9 owner-sign states {none,+,-}^2. Retain all passing Pareto-minimal tag modes per base; never choose by contradiction count or scalar rank.
guards: Frontier symbols are exact counts of available depth-zero signed tokens, not lower-bound interpretations of saturated tails.
No geometry label, occurrence profile, outcome-selected feature or scalar coefficient is added.
